--- is_distinct_from_parenthesized.sql
(TRUE OR FALSE) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (NULL IS NULL)

--- AST
&ast.IsDistinctFromExpr{
  Not:  true,
  Left: &ast.ParenExpr{
    Rparen: 14,
    Expr:   &ast.BinaryExpr{
      Op:   "OR",
      Left: &ast.BoolLiteral{
        ValuePos: 1,
        Value:    true,
      },
      Right: &ast.BoolLiteral{
        ValuePos: 9,
      },
    },
  },
  Right: &ast.ParenExpr{
    Lparen: 37,
    Rparen: 50,
    Expr:   &ast.IsNullExpr{
      Null: 46,
      Left: &ast.NullLiteral{
        Null: 38,
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
(TRUE OR FALSE) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (NULL IS NULL)
